_published_faq.name: How do I add GetYourGuide to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GetYourGuide to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://widget.getyourguide.com/apis/mcp-apps.

_published_faq.name: Is GetYourGuide MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, GetYourGuide scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GetYourGuide MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GetYourGuide provides these MCP tools: search_activities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GetYourGuide?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GetYourGuide in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
GetYourGuide does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
